items.title: 29.6.2 Molecular ion peak aur fragmentation (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the molecular ion peak and fragmentation (PDF 196-199).

blocks.text: Jab molecules par tez electrons ki bauchhaar ho to woh aik electron kho kar aik unpaired electron wala musbat molecular ion banate hain: molecule + e- -> molecule.+ + 2e- (kitab molecule -> molecule.+ + e- likhti hai). Molecular ion mazeed toot kar naye ions, molecules aur free radicals bana sakta hai.

Har peak khaas m/e wale ion se mutaliq hai. Sab se zyada m/e wali peak aam taur par molecular ion (M+) peak hai, jo compound ka molecular mass deti hai. Misal 29.4 mein molecular ion peak m/e 58 par hai, is liye spectrum propanal, CH3CH2CHO (Mr 58), ka hai, butanal, CH3CH2CH2CHO (Mr 72), ka nahi.

blocks.alt: Lakeeron wala mass spectrum, relative intensity (0 se 100) aur m/e (10 se 75). Sab se oonchi peaks m/e 27, 28 aur 29 (taqreeban 60, 90 aur 99) aur m/e 58 (taqreeban 85) par; chhoti peaks 15, 18, 26, 30, 39, 57 aur 59 ke qareeb.
blocks.caption: Misal 29.4: mass spectrum (Misal 29.4 ke saath chhape spectrum ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Mukhtalif compounds ka molecular mass aik ho sakta hai, is liye fragmentation banawat dhoondne mein madad deti hai. Tukre chhote khaas ions ki shakal mein ya chhote molecules ke nikalne se aate hain, maslan 18 (H2O), 29 (C2H5+) aur 44 (CO2) par peaks. Saada alkanes apne C-C bonds par toot'te hain: seedhi zanjeer wala hexane 86 (C6H14+), 71 (C5H11+), 57 (C4H9+), 43 (C3H7+), 29 (C2H5+) aur 15 (CH3+) par peaks deta hai.

blocks.caption: Hexane ke aam tukre (kitab ka Table 29.3)

blocks.text: M+1 peak molecule mein carbon-13 ki wajah se hai. Tamam carbon atoms ka taqreeban 1.1% 13C hai, is liye M+1 peak M peak se kaheen chhoti hai, aur molecule mein jitne zyada carbon atoms, us ki M+1 peak utni oonchi (hexane ki M+1 peak ethane ki nisbat bari hai). Carbon atoms ki tadaad, n, n = (100 x M+1 ki miqdar) / (1.1 x M+ ki miqdar) hai. Misal 29.5 mein m/e 58 par M peak ki miqdar taqreeban 85 aur 59 par M+1 peak ki miqdar 3 hai, is liye n = (100 x 3) / (1.1 x 85) = 3.21, yani teen carbon atoms.

blocks.alt: Compound X ka lakeeron wala mass spectrum, relative abundance (0 se 100) aur m/e (10 se 60). m/e 43 (taqreeban 98) aur m/e 58 (taqreeban 84) par oonchi peaks, 15 par peak (taqreeban 24), 59 par chhoti peak (3) aur kuch aur chhoti peaks.
blocks.caption: Misal 29.5: compound X ka mass spectrum (Misal 29.5 ke saath chhape spectrum ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Is spectrum mein m/e 58 ki oonchi peak M (molecular ion) aur us ke saath 59 ki chhoti peak M+1 hai. In ki unchaiyan (taqreeban 85 aur 3) formula n = 100 x 3 / (1.1 x 85) mein dalein to n = 3.21, yani 3 carbon atoms. Kitab ke khaake mein 59 ki peak 3 se thodi oonchi chhapi hai; hamare khaake mein kitab ke matn ke mutabiq 3 hai.

Bromine aur chlorine atoms M+2 (aur shayad M+4) peak dete hain. Chlorine 35Cl aur 37Cl ki shakal mein 3:1 ke tanasub mein hai, is liye aik Cl atom wala compound M aur M+2 peaks 3:1 mein, aur do Cl atoms wala M, M+2 aur M+4 9:6:1 mein dikhata hai. Bromine 79Br aur 81Br ki taqreeban barabar miqdar mein hai, is liye aik Br atom barabar unchai ki M aur M+2 peaks (1:1), aur do Br atoms M, M+2 aur M+4 1:2:1 mein dete hain.

blocks.alt: % abundance aur m/e ke chaar lakeeron wale spectra. 1 Cl atom wale compounds: 35 par 3 (M+ peak) aur 37 par 1 ([M + 2] peak). 2 Cl atoms: 70 par 9 (M+ peak), 72 par 6 ([M + 2] peak) aur 74 par 1 ([M + 4] peak). 1 Br atom: barabar peaks, 79 par 1 (M+ peak) aur 81 par 1 ([M + 2] peak). 2 Br atoms: 158 par 1 (M+ peak), 160 par 2 ([M + 2] peak) aur 162 par 1 ([M + 4] peak).
blocks.caption: Chlorine aur bromine atoms wale compounds ki M+, [M + 2] aur [M + 4] peaks (29.6.2 mein chhape chaar spectra ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Peak ke oopar likha number us ki unchai ka tanasub hai. Kitab ke '2 Br atoms' wale khaake mein beech wali [M + 2] peak par bhi '1' chhapa hai, halaan ke kitab ka apna tanasub 1:2:1 hai aur khaaka bhi is peak ko doguna ooncha dikhata hai; hamare khaake mein is par '2' likha hai. Wajah: 79Br-81Br do tareeqon (79+81 aur 81+79) se ban sakta hai, is liye M + 2 doguni hai.

blocks.prompt: (i) C4H10, (ii) C5H12, (iii) C7H16 ke mumkin tukre (seedhi zanjeer alkanes ke taur par) batayein.

blocks.alt: CH3Br ka lakeeron wala mass spectrum: % abundance aur m/e (10 se 120). m/e 15 par oonchi peak aur m/e 94 aur 96 par do barabar, thodi chhoti peaks.
blocks.caption: Quick Check 29.3: CH3Br ka mass spectrum (Quick Check mein chhape spectrum ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: CH3Br ke mass spectrum mein 15, 94 aur 96 par peaks hain. Har aik pehchanein, aur 94 aur 96 par do peaks ki wajah batayein.
blocks.explanation: 15 CH3+ hai; 94 CH3(79Br)+ aur 96 CH3(81Br)+, yani molecular ions (M aur M+2). Do is liye ke bromine ke do isotopes, 79Br aur 81Br, taqreeban barabar miqdar mein hain, is liye peaks taqreeban barabar unchai (1:1) ki hain.

items: Sab se zyada m/e wali peak (M+) molecular mass deti.
